start.text: Free today, sir. Tomorrow you pay like everyone - token from the machine, tap on the gate, it opens. Don't jump the flap, the camera sees.

train.text: Up there, standing. Doors close when they feel like it. Go, go - first train, you'll tell your children.

machine.text: The left one eats notes. The right one eats notes slower. Today nobody needs either - tell that uncle, he won't listen to me.

bye.text: Enjoy. Four years we waited for this.

again.text: Still free, sir. Still standing. Go sit in it before the whole of Whitefield does.

kid_handover.text: Whose child? Spider-Man, come here. Sir, I'll put him on the announcement, the mother will come running. Go, enjoy the train. Good man.
